## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A consumer repository records the installed toolkit version and payload hash...

The system SHALL ensure that a consumer repository records the installed toolkit version and payload hash in a tracked file registered in docs/guides/state-artifacts.md.

#### Scenario: A consumer repository records the installed toolkit version and payload hash...

WHEN `toolkit-consistency` is implemented
THEN A consumer repository records the installed toolkit version and payload hash in a tracked file registered in docs/guides/state-artifacts.md.

### Requirement: install.sh --check reports drift between the pinned version and the local...

The system SHALL ensure that install.sh --check reports drift between the pinned version and the local runtime copy.

#### Scenario: install.sh --check reports drift between the pinned version and the local...

WHEN `toolkit-consistency` is implemented
THEN install.sh --check reports drift between the pinned version and the local runtime copy.

### Requirement: Repository-scoped learnings are opt-in and never include private transcript...

The system SHALL ensure that repository-scoped learnings are opt-in and never include private transcript content.

#### Scenario: Repository-scoped learnings are opt-in and never include private transcript...

WHEN `toolkit-consistency` is implemented
THEN Repository-scoped learnings are opt-in and never include private transcript content.

### Requirement: Installed payloads contain no references to private coordinator source

The system SHALL ensure that installed payloads contain no references to private coordinator source.

#### Scenario: Installed payloads contain no references to private coordinator source

WHEN `toolkit-consistency` is implemented
THEN Installed payloads contain no references to private coordinator source.
